name: Form 3 Mathematics Term 1 Exam
subject: Mathematics
instructions: Answer ALL questions. Show all working. Mathematical tables may be used.

items.question: The nth term of the sequence 2, 5, 8, 11 is?

sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Solve the quadratic equation: x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0 (4 marks)
2. Use the triangle in the diagram to find the length of the side marked x. (4 marks)
3. Find the sum of the first 20 terms of the arithmetic series 3 + 7 + 11 + ... (4 marks)
4. Make r the subject of the formula: V = 1/3 pi r^2 h (3 marks)
6. A ladder 5 m long leans against a wall making an angle of 60 degrees with the ground. Find the height reached on the wall. (4 marks)
7. Solve the simultaneous equations: 3x + 2y = 12 and 2x - y = 1 (4 marks)
8. The probability that it rains on a given day is 0.3. Find the probability that it does not rain. (2 marks)
